name: Mayor
source:
"Gold Cord is in a terrible crisis right now!!!"

The mayor of Gold Cord.
Facing galactic invasions head on, she makes innovative proposals that nobody goes along with.
That's why she throws a tantrum and cries at the most critical moments.
